mapper.update: update chooseorder set CHOOSEVALUE=CHOOSEVALUE+#{chooseValue} where USERUNIQUE=#{userUnique} and PERIOD=#{period} and MARKETNAME like #{marketName} and PRODUCTNAME like #{productName}
update allordersofgroup set STATUS=STATUS + #{isChosen} where ORDERID = #{orderId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from chooseorder where GROUPNAME=#{groupName} and PERIOD=#{period}
